jetbrains.pluginmarket.words-to-search-f: Words to search for (empty lists every plugin):
jetbrains.pluginmarket.smith-printed-the: smith printed the plugins in a form this plugin does not read. Update the plugin.
jetbrains.pluginmarket.pick-a-plugin-the: Pick a plugin. The newest version is installed.
jetbrains.pluginmarket.also-trust-it-in-: Also trust it in this workspace (--trust)
jetbrains.pluginmarket.also-pin-the-sha-: Also pin the SHA-256 of its program in smith.toml, which CI checks (--pin)
jetbrains.pluginmarket.is-a-program-that: {name} {newest} is a program that runs on your computer{value}. smith checks the archive's SHA-256 and file list and every path before it installs. Installing does not trust it: --trust records that you trust it in this workspace. Nothing is committed.
